P77.affine_recurrence: scan forward bits at positions j from zero; on bit 1 replace B by 3B+2^j and on bit 0 leave B unchanged
P77.code_property: the first-upcrossing family U is prefix-free
P77.endpoint_bits: every nontrivial forward block starts with 1 and ends with 0; w=u=1 is the unique length-one exception
P77.first_upcrossing: every nonempty proper prefix p of u_i has 3^q(p)<2^L(p), while 3^q(u_i)>2^L(u_i)
P77.orientation: w_i=s_[t_i,t_(i+1)) is the forward block and u_i=reverse(w_i)
P77.strict_suffix_minimum: t_0=0 and t_(i+1) is the unique argmin of Delta_n over n>t_i
P77.uniqueness_boundary: the forward infinite decomposition is unique because the strict suffix-minimum times are unique, not because reverse(U) is prefix-free

what_this_result_does_not_prove: P77 supplies a symbolic decomposition under permanent safety and discrepancy escape; it does not prove either hypothesis for every Collatz orbit without P74's external input.
